messages:
anne_w: Heads-up — I'm proposing a tiny addition to the deploy bot to speed up small rollouts and standardize our change-window field. Idea: a compact subcommand `deploy quick` that wires default canary+rollback flags and auto-fills release-note template.
ram_patel: nice. can we keep explicit pinning? most hotfixes need exact version pins.
anne_w: yes — pin required by default for quick. syntax suggestion: `deploy quick --pin v1234 --cw 2h --canary 10%`
kevin_g: can the bot auto-create the release-note stub in the PR body and in the release channel? that'd save copying.
anne_w: exactly. bot flow: 1) create release-note stub 2) post ephemeral checklist to deployper 3) run canary set 4) monitor basic metrics 5) auto-rollback on defined alerts
maya_s: what alerts? we should keep them lightweight for quick deploys (5xx rate, p50 latency, error-rate delta).
ram_patel: propose defaults: 5xx > 1% absolute or +200% relative, p50 latency +300ms, custom health-check failing for >2 minutes.
kevin_g: +1 on defaults. also need an escape hatch to force-forward: `--force` but warn and require a reason.
anne_w: draft bot command prototype:
```
/deploy quick --pin v1234 --cw 2h --canary 10% --notes "tiny auth fix"
```
Bot behavior: create PR release note, post in #releases with link, run canary (10% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> 100%), auto-check metrics at each step, if trigger -> pause + rollback.
ram_patel: can the bot add a `pin-annotation` to manifests? like `x-release-pin: v1234` so infra pipeline can pick it up without manual edits.
maya_s: good call. that solves drift. add a `--annotate` flag default on.
deploy-bot: @anne_w I implemented a dry-run for `deploy quick` in staging. Usage: `/deploy quick --pin vSTG-42 --cw 30m --canary 5% --notes "dry-run"`
kevin_g: tried dry-run, saw the stub PR and the checklist popup, nice. two suggestions: shorten checklist to 3 items and add a quick rollback button in PR.
anne_w: shortened checklist = 
- confirm pin
- confirm change window
- sanity-check logs
I'll add rollback button idea to the PR template (GH action that calls bot).
ram_patel: edge case: multi-service rollouts where pins must be coordinated. can we support a `--bundle <file>` that contains pins for services and a single change-window?
maya_s: yes please. so ops can ship cross-service hotfixes.
anne_w: wire format suggestion for bundle (yaml):
```yaml
services:
  - name: auth
    pin: v1234
  - name: api-gateway
    pin: v987
change_window: 1h
canary: 10%
```
kevin_g: needs validation step before applying. a `--validate` option would run dry checks and report conflicts.
deploy-bot: Validation complete for staging bundle: no conflicts found. Would you like to apply? (buttons: Apply / Cancel)
ram_patel: one more: telemetry tags on the release so QA can filter. `--tag release-day-2026-03-xyz`
anne_w: yep. final checklist for implementation: commit CLI flag parsing + bundle support, auto-PR note + rollback button GH action, manifest annotation, default alert thresholds + override flags, dry-run UX, small docs page + examples.
kevin_g: timeline? can we try an alpha next week on staging?
anne_w: I can land a first pass by Friday. we'll demo on next release sync. :thumbsup:
